summary_1line: Bhima withstands and counterattacks ten Kaurava warriors, cripples Jayadratha’s chariot, and is joined by Arjuna as the battle intensifies.

image_candidates.scene_text: Surrounded by many chariots, Bhima stands firm on his chariot like a mountain in rain while volleys of arrows strike him from every side.
With swift arrows Bhima slays Jayadratha’s horses and charioteer, leaving the Sindhu king leaping from his ruined chariot amid the chaos of battle.
Arjuna arrives with Sikhandin before him, driving his chariot toward Bhima as the Kaurava warriors lose hope at the sight of the two Pandava heroes together.
